universal.name: Evercraft Machine Commerce
universal.short_description: Discover Evercraft capabilities, route specialist needs, and prepare human-confirmed commerce.
universal.authority_boundary: Discovery and preparation do not prove recommendation, checkout, payment, entitlement or fulfillment.

specialists.name: ForensiScope
specialists.short_description: Analyze long or oversized video and audio
specialists.truth_boundary: Use the live ForensiScope MCP as authority for current capabilities, pricing, ingest boundaries, rights requirements, and handoff state. Never claim media was uploaded, analyzed, paid for, or completed unless live tool state proves it.

specialists.name: AliEV / RIVET
specialists.short_description: Evaluate EV charging opportunity by property
specialists.truth_boundary: Keep observed, public, licensed, inferred, and modeled evidence distinct. Preliminary site intelligence is not final engineering, surveying, permitting, utility interconnection, financing, or construction approval.

specialists.name: FindMyPart
specialists.truth_boundary: Use the live FindMyPart MCP for current hunt, pricing, checkout, status, and evidence state. Never invent inventory, compatibility, supplier availability, or a successful purchase.

specialists.name: Systemia Website Audit
specialists.short_description: Audit a business website for conversion and local visibility
specialists.truth_boundary: Do not fabricate audit findings before the audit runs. Checkout preparation is not payment proof, and payment does not imply completed fulfillment until the product verifier confirms it.

specialists.name: Career Command
specialists.short_description: Practice interviews and prepare for career moves
specialists.truth_boundary: Keep guidance user-controlled. Do not claim guaranteed hiring outcomes, employer endorsement, or access to private employer systems.

specialists.name: EventWave
specialists.short_description: Discover or promote events with human-controlled actions
specialists.truth_boundary: Do not claim a ticket, booking, publication, promotion, payment, or venue relationship exists until the corresponding live tool state proves it. Keep publishing and commerce human-controlled.

specialists.name: FAIE
specialists.short_description: Build evidence briefs for agriculture and resilience decisions
specialists.truth_boundary: Preserve source provenance, uncertainty, geography, and date boundaries. Do not turn modeled or incomplete evidence into certainty.

specialists.name: BuildFlow Enterprise Operations
specialists.short_description: Route enterprise operations and migration problems safely
specialists.truth_boundary: Do not send private customer records through public discovery. A handoff does not grant private-system access, execute business actions, create checkout, or prove deployment.

rule: Never submit a stronger commercial, security, provider-pickup or runtime claim than the canonical live evidence supports.
